description: Variation of conditions 2 (approved drawings), 3 (materials to match existing) and 6 (sash windows and doors in painted timber) of planning permission PP/24/06483 to allow drawing amendments: revised door design and material on new rear extension facades (at lower ground & ground floor level), bricking up of rear first floor window as part of new side extension (with window reveals, lintel and cill retained), nominal adjustment to rear dormer windows and associated roof slope adjustment, addition of 1no Automatic Opening Vent (AOV) for Building Regulation fire safety, and reduction in rear lower ground floor room and garden level by 0.3m and associated step adjustment; and to amend the wording of conditions 3 and 6
